_about: Third-party code with published ground truth, pinned to a commit. Scanned, never executed.

suites.name: owasp-benchmark-python

suites.name: securityeval

suites.name: vulnerable-snippets-js

suites.name: vulnerable-node-seeds
suites.about: vulnerable-node's SAST seeds: one known vulnerability per file plus clean controls that must stay quiet. Not held out: its first scan missed the SQL concatenation, NoSQL operator, prototype pollution and deserialization seeds and raised a false alarm on a clean control, which led to the JS guard sanitizer, SQL value-formatting and prototype-pollution rules. Measures detection and false alarms.

suites.name: cve-pairs-python
suites.about: Python CVE fix pairs. Reviewed GitHub advisories with exactly one fix commit that changes at most three non-test source files (120 lines or fewer) in web application code, i.e. request input reaching a sink in the project's own code rather than inside a framework or library. The commit before the fix is scanned for detection: a finding of the advisory's weakness near the changed lines, or one the fix makes go away. The fix commit is scanned for false alarms: such a finding that survives the fix or appears at it. Not held out: may be used to adjust rules (say so here when that happens). GHSA-9x43-5qcq-h79q (Grappelli) was used on 2026-10-31 to accept url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme(url=...) as a redirect check; GHSA-f2mf-q878-gh58 (Parsl), GHSA-h6m6-jj8v-94jj (litellm) and GHSA-8whx-v8qq-pq64 (changedetection.io) to add Flask route and FastAPI text parameters as request sources, pandas and Prisma raw-SQL sinks, and typed Flask converters; GHSA-6rmf-cv6p-4h27 (django-termsandconditions) and GHSA-g3cm-qg2v-2hj5 (pyLoad), at their fix commits, to add values used inside a passing is_safe/is_valid-style check, request.url_root/host_url as redirect bases, and calls to project functions that can't return a parameter as clean (this loses GHSA-g3cm's vulnerable commit, whose flaw is its own is_safe_url). Cases added 2026-11-02 were chosen from GitHub's reviewed pip advisories since 2021 (CWE 22, 79, 89, 94, 502, 601, 611, 78, 918, 1336) by fix size, then read one by one; the decisions and reasons are in PLAN.md step 22. On 2026-11-02 (PLAN.md step 22, first round) GHSA-527m-2xhr-j27g, GHSA-wc6j-5g83-xfm6, GHSA-48rp-jc79-2264 and GHSA-vwhf-3v6x-wff8 at their fixes were used to accept raising validators named for what they check, base + os.sep prefix checks on resolved paths, Flask make_response of a dict or list, and lookups through a store; GHSA-h454-rq3m-89rc (Django URL arguments), GHSA-9jj8-v89v-xjvw (route parameters tainted where declared, name-only re.sub), GHSA-r25m-cr6v-p9hq (FileResponse, sanitise_ names) and GHSA-g53g-q539-93cv (requests url=) to add sources and sinks.

suites.name: cve-pairs-python-frontend
suites.about: CVE fix pairs in the templates and front-end JavaScript of Python web apps (Django, Flask, FastAPI): the fix changes a template or a script the app ships. Chosen and scored like cve-pairs-python, with templates (.html, Jinja) and JS/TS counted as source. Not held out: may be used to adjust rules (say so here when that happens). Cases added 2026-11-02 were chosen from GitHub's reviewed pip advisories since 2021 (CWE 22, 79, 89, 94, 502, 601, 611, 78, 918, 1336) by fix size, then read one by one; the decisions and reasons are in PLAN.md step 22. On 2026-11-02 GHSA-mxvc-fwgx-j778 (Whoogle) was used to add request data passed to a template variable printed with |safe as an XSS sink. On 2026-11-02 (second batch, a cloud session) 21 more cases were added from the same advisories, widened to all years, to fixes over three files or 120 lines when every change is the same weakness, and to advisories whose extra commits are backports of one fix (the main-branch commit is used); none used for rules yet. Decisions and reasons: PLAN.md step 22.
